verdict.rationale: The evidence repeatedly describes Jan as an "open-source" replacement for ChatGPT and Claude, which suggests there is no separate paid community or enterprise split. However, it never names the license or says whether commercial or enterprise use needs a paid license or subscription. Missing for 10: the named license (e.g., Apache/AGPL), an explicit statement on commercial or enterprise use terms, confirmation of whether any paid tier exists, and independent corroboration.
